input.prompt: A life-size ancient Greek cast bronze statue of a standing goddess of wisdom and war, Classical style of the 5th century BC, about 2.4 m tall including its plinth. Her raised right hand grips a long, sturdy spear held upright and close beside her right side, its butt resting on the plinth by her right foot and its leaf-shaped point a little above the helmet crest. Her lowered left hand rests on the rim of a large round shield (about 90 cm across) standing on edge on the plinth, leaning against her left leg, its outer face plain and smooth. She stands on a low square bronze plinth about 15 cm high, part of the casting. Isolated on a plain, seamless, uniform pure white background. Soft, even, diffuse studio lighting from all around: no harsh highlights, no cast shadow or contact shadow, no floor, no reflections of surroundings.
